not_made.reason: FreeCAD 0.21.2 has no built-in Assembly workbench
The native Hole DepthType supports Dimension and ThroughAll, but not a To-face extent.
Sheet metal requires the SheetMetal add-on, rather than a direct PartDesign feature.
Sheet-metal flanges require the SheetMetal add-on, rather than a direct PartDesign feature.
A sheet-metal flat pattern has no direct PartDesign feature.
Fusion component joints and driven positions are assembly history, not PartDesign features.
Fusion joint motion history and rest positions are not PartDesign features.
This release has no native two-angle Revolution extent.
This release has no native Revolution To-face extent.
Fusion cosmetic external threads and their modeled-history switch have no direct PartDesign equivalent.
Fusion Base Feature editing has no direct parametric PartDesign history equivalent.
A native Pad has no Thin Extrude mode; changing the profile to a ring would change the requested history.
Text emboss depends on a font and has no direct Sketcher text feature.
Fusion Align and Move/Copy history has no direct PartDesign feature.
PartDesign patterns features, not selected boundary faces.
A pattern of disconnected bodies is not a direct single-body PartDesign feature.
Fusion component and body visibility is assembly display state; FreeCAD Part and Body visibility is covered by N13.
Sketcher.Constraint rejects Lock; the UI lock operation uses dimensional constraints, not a native Lock type.
P14a and P14b require a 3D polyline sketch. Sketcher is planar; splitting the path across sketches or using a static wire would change the requested editable feature history.
The SheetMetal bend relief depth already defaults to 1, so S02h would be the same document as S02a.
The native SheetMetal corner-relief proxy has Circle, Square, and Sketch modes, but no Tear mode.
The add-on cuts a bend relief only where a flange is narrower than its edge; these flanges span their edges, so a round bend relief gives the same solid as S03a.
A 180-degree wall can approximate a hem, but there is no native single-hem gap/default-extent feature; the booklet leaves the hem length implicit.
The add-on has one rectangular relief shape, so S06c would be the same document as S06b.
The add-on cuts a bend relief only where a flange is narrower than its edge; S02a's flange spans its edge, so the relief width alone gives the same solid as S06a.
The add-on has no direct Bend joining the two separate Face features with these unspecified default bend options.
